title: The Tide Pool Walk
story: Lena left her white cotton gloves at the museum this morning, since nothing in a tide pool is likely to be older than she is. On her walk along Thimble Beach, she and three others each found one creature in a different pool. Everything must go back exactly where it came from before the tide turns. Who found what, and in which pool?

texts: The walker at Moon Pool found neither the crab nor the snail.
The snail's finder explored either Mermaid Pool or Moon Pool.
The walker at Kettle Pool found neither the crab nor the urchin.
The walker at Bathtub Pool is neither Lena nor Hugo.
Marta found either the snail or the sea star.
The walker at Kettle Pool is either Zeke or Hugo.

trace.text: Clue 2 limits the choices (mark the X's it gives).
The snail must go with Mermaid Pool: clue 2 rules out Bathtub Pool and Kettle Pool; clue 1 rules out Moon Pool.
The crab must go with Bathtub Pool: clue 3 rules out Kettle Pool; clue 1 rules out Moon Pool; Mermaid Pool already goes with the snail.
The urchin must go with Moon Pool: clue 3 rules out Kettle Pool; the other choices are already taken.
The sea star must go with Kettle Pool: the other choices are already taken.
Clue 5 limits the choices (mark the X's it gives).
The crab must go with Zeke: clue 5 rules out Marta; Lena and Hugo are already ruled out for Bathtub Pool.
Bathtub Pool must go with Zeke: clue 4 rules out Lena and Hugo; Marta is already ruled out for the crab.
Clue 6 limits the choices (mark the X's it gives).
Marta must go with Mermaid Pool: clue 6 rules out Kettle Pool; Bathtub Pool is already ruled out for the crab; Moon Pool is already ruled out for the urchin.
Lena must go with Moon Pool: clue 4 rules out Bathtub Pool; clue 6 rules out Kettle Pool; Mermaid Pool already goes with Marta.
Hugo must go with Kettle Pool: clue 4 rules out Bathtub Pool; the other choices are already taken.
The snail goes with Mermaid Pool, so the snail also goes with Marta.
The urchin goes with Moon Pool, so the urchin also goes with Lena.
Hugo must go with the sea star: the crab is already ruled out for Bathtub Pool; the other choices are already taken.
